# Compose Resource Editor

IntelliJ plugin that provides an editable table view for Compose Multiplatform `strings.xml` translation files.

**Disclaimer:** Everything in this repo was generated by AI. I have no intention to further develop this — I only wanted the functionality until JetBrains ships the official Translations Editor ([KMT-1017](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KMT-1017/Translations-Editor-for-Compose-Multiplatform)).
